faqs.question: Can I rely on this Losartan potassium information instead of a doctor visit?

faqs.question: Can I adjust the dose of Losartan potassium on my own?
faqs.answer: Dose changes should only be made with clinician guidance. Self-adjustment can increase side effects or reduce effectiveness.
